tasks.title: Support Escaping Backtick Characters
tasks.prompt: Implement and export escapeHtml.withBackticks(string) in index.js that escapes HTML characters ('"', '&', ''', '<', '>') and additionally escapes backtick characters ('`') to '`'.

tasks.title: Export unescape Helper Function
tasks.prompt: Implement and export escapeHtml.unescape(string) in index.js that unescapes HTML entities (", &, ', <, >) back to their respective characters.

tasks.title: Export isEscapeNeeded Helper
tasks.prompt: Implement and export escapeHtml.isEscapeNeeded(string) in index.js that returns boolean true if the input string contains any characters requiring HTML escaping, and false otherwise.

tasks.title: Export attribute Safe Escaper
tasks.prompt: Implement and export escapeHtml.attribute(string) in index.js that escapes characters for HTML attributes (escaping '"', '&', ''', '<', '>').

tasks.title: Export Template Tag Literal Helper
tasks.prompt: Implement and export escapeHtml.tag(strings, ...values) in index.js as an ES6 template tag function that automatically escapes interpolated expression values while leaving template literal string parts intact.

tasks.title: Expose Package Version Property
tasks.prompt: Expose a version property on the exported escapeHtml function (escapeHtml.version) in index.js set to the string '1.0.3'.

tasks.title: Support Null-Safe Escaping Method
tasks.prompt: Implement and export escapeHtml.safe(string) in index.js that returns an empty string '' when input is null or undefined, and otherwise behaves like escapeHtml(string).

tasks.title: Support Forward Slash Escaping
tasks.prompt: Implement and export escapeHtml.withSlash(string) in index.js that escapes HTML characters and additionally escapes forward slash characters ('/') to '/'.

tasks.title: Export Escape Map Dictionary
tasks.prompt: Export escapeHtml.escapeMap in index.js containing character-to-entity mappings for '"', '&', ''', '<', and '>'.

tasks.title: Support Custom Replacement Map
tasks.prompt: Implement and export escapeHtml.custom(string, map) in index.js that replaces any characters present as keys in the provided map object with their corresponding replacement values.
